mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 60 degrees at Verona Community Park. The International Space Station will be visible tonight for two minutes, rising over Mount Horeb and moving toward Belleville. The overnight low will be 46 degrees with no rain expected.

October is officially Community Planning Month, a time to recognize our planning department's dedication. Also, if you need a lift, the Senior Center is offering free rides on their tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Live music is playing today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, and tomorrow you can check out the Dane County Farmers' Market or enjoy music at Paddy Mac's.
In a recent report, on September 21, a retail theft occurred in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue where an individual was identified and cited for taking candy.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor, as the store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM.
